huawei_pv_generation_watts.help: Current PV (inverter input) power in watts.

huawei_grid_export_watts.help: Current power exported to the grid in watts (>= 0).

huawei_grid_import_watts.help: Current power imported from the grid in watts (>= 0).

huawei_home_consumption_watts.help: Home consumption in watts (PV input minus battery power minus net grid power).

huawei_grid_net_watts.help: Net grid power in watts (positive = export by default).

huawei_battery_net_watts.help: Battery net power in watts (positive = charging, negative = discharging).

huawei_battery_charge_watts.help: Battery charging power in watts (0 when not charging).

huawei_battery_discharge_watts.help: Battery discharging power in watts (0 when not discharging).

huawei_battery_soc_percent.help: Battery state of charge in percent.

huawei_cache_device_up.help: 1 when the modbus-cache in front of the device finished its last poll cycle with at least one successful read, 0 when the device is unreachable behind the cache.

huawei_cache_age_seconds.help: Seconds since the modbus-cache's last successful device read (65535 = none yet). Grows while the device is down behind the cache.

huawei_cache_uptime_seconds.help: Uptime of the modbus-cache process in seconds.

huawei_battery.help: 1 if battery support is enabled (always exported).

huawei_up.help: 1 if the last Modbus poll of the inverter succeeded.

huawei_modbus_errors_total.help: Total failed or rejected polls since start.

huawei_last_poll_timestamp_seconds.help: Unix time of the last successful poll.
